metadata.track_name: Implement SPL(Java) flow control in TypeScript (spl-flow)
metadata.goal: Add grid-based flow execution and SPL control-flow statements (if/for/break/next/goto/func/return/try) to packages/spl-flow, aligning behavior with Java SPL while keeping Web-IDE's no-leading-'=' input style.

phase.name: Spec & Design Lock
phase.description: Lock the exact SPL subset and the TypeScript compatibility rules.

tasks.task:
Confirm the exact statement set in-scope: if/elseif/else, for (n/range/sequence/while), break/next, goto, func/return/result/end, try. Explicitly exclude fork/reduce/channel.
codument/tracks/impl-flow-control/spec.md codument/tracks/impl-flow-control/design.md
Spec explicitly lists in-scope statements and excludes fork/reduce/channel. Spec includes scenarios for each in-scope statement, including a decision to support #<cellRef> loop sequence syntax.
Define how TS flow treats plain cells (default expression) and whether to accept Java-style '='/'>' prefixes as optional compatibility.

phase.name: Flow Program Model
phase.description: Introduce cell model + classification + grid index (no behavior changes yet).

tasks.task: Build a normalized grid representation from FlowCell[] and classify cells as blank/comment/expression/command.

phase.name: Execution Engine Core
phase.description: Port PgmCellSet-style navigation (cur position, setNext, block boundary, stack).

tasks.task: Implement indentation-scoped blocks and deterministic navigation across row/col while skipping blank/comment cells.
Ensure flows without any command cells behave like the current implementation (same scope + lastQuery behavior).

phase.name: If / ElseIf / Else
phase.description: Implement conditional branching with both same-row and multi-row else/elseif forms.

tasks.task: Add command parsing and execution for if/elseif/else, including branch search and skip rules.

phase.name: For / Break / Next
phase.description: Implement loop variants and loop-control statements.

tasks.task: Support for (infinite), for n, for start,end[,step], for sequenceExpr, for conditionExpr.
Support break/next on nearest loop and break/next targeting outer loop by cellRef.
Implement goto and enforce safety rules (no jump into deeper indentation / loop body).

phase.name: Subroutines + Result/End
phase.description: Implement func (subroutines)/return/result/end; support func(masterCell, ...) invocation semantics.

tasks.task: Implement SPL subroutine semantics: - A "func" command cell is a subroutine master cell; its body is the indented block. - The subroutine body does not execute during normal top-level flow execution. - Invoke as func(A1, x1, x2, ...) where A1 is a cellRef literal. - On invocation, assign x1..xn into cells starting at A1 and moving right (A1,B1,C1,...), then execute the block until return or block end. - If no return executes, return the last expression-cell value inside the subroutine block.
Implement result to terminate flow with a value; implement end to terminate with optional error message.

phase.name: Try
phase.description: Implement SPL-style try blocks with error capture semantics.

tasks.task: Capture errors thrown within try block execution, store message into the try cell, and continue after the block.
